comparison_scope: same year and same source subcategory
methodology_condition: Same eligible survey surface; survey phase and methodology status retained
prohibited_use: Do not relabel TBI as market share or compare across subcategories.
notes: Public coverage is selective and survey phase is not exposed on the captured comparison pages.

comparison_scope: longitudinal within one brand and source subcategory
methodology_condition: Historical methodology continuity must be validated; no category or label break
prohibited_use: Do not calculate momentum across an unresolved methodology, category, identity, or ownership break.
notes: Blank year cells remain explicit unavailable observations.

prohibited_use: Do not average or rank TBI values across categories.
notes: TBI values are category-specific source-native indices.

prohibited_use: Do not convert missing values to zero, interpolate, or carry values forward.

comparison_scope: same national edition and documented ranking universe
methodology_condition: National coverage documented; public facts remain selective
prohibited_use: Do not treat rank as interval scale or infer ranks for omitted brands.
notes: Public summaries are not a complete redistributable ranking universe.

prohibited_use: Do not infer a numeric growth rate, rank, or portfolio-wide momentum.
notes: Preserve the qualitative statement without manufacturing a numeric value.

prohibited_use: Do not infer CRP, penetration, purchase frequency, or market share.
notes: Selection wording is source-native context only.

prohibited_use: Do not convert the lower bound into an exact estimate or compare it with a point estimate.
notes: A statement of more than 40% is stored as lower_bound=40, not exact 40%.

prohibited_use: Do not count omitted brands as outside the Top 100 or use selected entries as portfolio breadth.
notes: Public-summary omission is not a zero or negative result.

prohibited_use: Do not combine rank change with exact rank, CRP, penetration, or TBI.
notes: Le Minerale is additionally restricted to extended-group sensitivity.

prohibited_use: Do not join to national urban-rural editions as an ordinary longitudinal series.
notes: Urban editions form a separate candidate cluster.

methodology_condition: National coverage documented and reference period resolved
prohibited_use: Do not use publication year as consumer reference period without documentation.
notes: The 2023 edition retains an additional methodology-documentation caveat.

prohibited_use: Do not calculate ordinary year-over-year movement across the coverage break.
notes: The verified break begins with the 2021 national edition.

comparison_scope: Top Brand versus Brand Footprint or another metric family
prohibited_use: Do not pool TBI, CRP, penetration, rank, reach bounds, text statuses, or booleans into one scale.
notes: Cross-source evidence may be synthesized only at the dimension level after separate interpretation.

methodology_condition: Ownership period invalid for the reference period
prohibited_use: Do not attribute the observation to the former owner.
notes: Historical observations remain eligible only within valid ownership periods.

prohibited_use: Do not include related affiliates or joint ventures in strict-control primary aggregation.
notes: Sensitivity results must remain separately labeled.

comparison_scope: same construct after an explicit reversible transformation
geography_or_cluster: Same validated geography and methodology cluster
methodology_condition: Transformation preserves meaning and is documented
prohibited_use: Do not transform ordinal ranks into interval values or pool incompatible units.
notes: The transformation and original source-native value must both remain reproducible.

comparison_scope: same construct with fully matching definition and coverage
methodology_condition: No known identity, ownership, category, period, or methodology break
prohibited_use: Do not apply when selective coverage or unresolved caveats remain.
notes: This class is available but is not assigned automatically to the current limited public facts.
